data.body: Classification: behavioral. Fix in dso_ci_review/runner.py _post_pr_review: when a finding lacks cited_lines anchor, synthesize one from the first added line of the first changed file in the PR diff (via gh pr diff --patch parsing). This promotes fragile/unanchored findings into the Reviews API path → resolvable review threads visible to merge-to-main.sh resolve_phase, /dso:respond-to-pr-comments, and the GitHub review-thread UI. Synthesis failure falls through to existing issue-comment path.
